title: HATED FOR THE SAKE OF TRUTH

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first." (John 15:18)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
No one wants to be hated. However, when we follow Jesus, hatred becomes our traveling companion. The world does not accept the truth because it prefers darkness (lies). Lies parade around with deceptive beauty, filled with pride, color, and glamour. But truth comes only with simplicity and purity.
Jesus is the truth, yet the world hated Him. Even though He was pure, they crucified Him. When we desire to stand for the truth, opposition comes instead of applause. The evangelists, popes, and saints who stood unshakeable received no applause on earth, but they had a crown of victory in heaven.
When no one stood by Stephen's side, he boldly proclaimed the truth all by himself. The world stoned him. But heaven opened, and Jesus stood up to welcome him. In heaven's perspective, that was a magnificent welcoming ceremony!
Truth is a divider. Sometimes, it leaves a person standing entirely alone. But God considers the person who is hated for the sake of truth as uniquely His own.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "You are hated by the world not because you are wrong, but because you truthfully speak the truth in the midst of the world." - Leonard Ravenhill

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, give me the courage to live with a heart that seeks truth over praise. Even if everyone forsakes me, You alone are enough. Establish an unfailing hope within me. Like Stephen, I want to finish my race with joyful triumph filled completely with truth and faith. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: If you are hated for the truth, you are honored in heaven.
You will stand for Him; He will rise up for you!
